mkp-diagrams:sequence@1.name: sequence
mkp-diagrams:sequence@1.about: A sequence diagram that plays: participants as lanes with dashed lifelines, one row per message with its time, the current message lit and the ones to come faint. A message to its own sender is a note on its lane; a lost one stops half way with a cross; replies are dashed.

inputs.name: actors
inputs.about: the participants, left to right (up to six)

inputs.name: messages
inputs.about: in the order they are sent: to its own sender (or to none) is a note on that lane; lost never arrives; time is the left column's text; note is said in the bar while it is current

inputs.name: title
inputs.about: the header's title

inputs.name: unit
inputs.about: the time's unit, said after it in the bar (ms, s)

inputs.name: size
inputs.about: kept for older documents: the diagram is as tall as its rows
